rotationSign: CSS rotate(); positive = clockwise on screen

swim.howTo: Swim: set #swim display to inline (e.g. el.removeAttribute('display') or CSS #swim{display:inline}) and set display:none on #leg-near and #leg-far. Place the duck so y=238 (waterline) sits on the pond surface. Bob with #body +-4.

fly.howTo: Flap by alternating #wing-near between +80 (up) and -35 (down) and #wing-far between +112 and -20 (both nested in #body). Tilt #body -8 and tuck the legs back (+30) while flying.

parts.description: Far leg and webbed foot (darker); pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward). Hide while swimming.
Near leg and webbed foot; pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward). Hide while swimming.
Torso; pivot at the hips over the legs. Contains both wings, the tail and the head (+ tips forward, - leans back; use -8 when flying).
Far wing (darker), behind the body; nested in 'body', pivot at the shoulder (+ raises it, - lowers it).
Little pointed tail; nested in 'body', pivot at the root (+ tips forward/upright, - tips back/down; a quick -15/+15 is a waggle).
Head with bill, eye and tuft; nested in 'body', neck base hidden behind the body (+ dips forward, - lifts).
Near wing over the body; nested in 'body', pivot at the shoulder (+ raises it, - lowers it).
Water ripple band at the waterline, in front of the lower body. Hidden by default (display="none"); show it and hide both legs to swim.
